story: Clean text PDF. Every line matches PO-24051 exactly, inter-state IGST is correct.
PO-24060 covers 3 months. Jul and Aug are already billed. Sep uses the last of the PO, so it fits.
Looks fine on its own, but the PO was for 3 months. Cumulative billing goes past the PO value.
Same invoice as BSE/2526/0042 (already paid) with the number reformatted and a new date.
Image-only scan with no PO number. The process has to OCR it and infer which open PO it belongs to.
Total is within 0.3% of the PO, but 5 fewer chairs at a 14% higher unit price.
Everything matches except the bank account, which differs from the vendor master. Classic payment-fraud pattern.
Vendor isn't in the master, the GSTIN check digit is wrong and the PO doesn't exist.
A proforma sent instead of a tax invoice: no invoice number, no date. It can't be booked.
Vendor and buyer are both in Haryana, so it should be CGST + SGST. IGST was charged. Total is right, tax head is wrong.
Stretch film is 1% above the PO rate. That's inside the 2% price tolerance, so it auto-approves with a note.
Box price is 3.5% over PO (a freight surcharge procurement agreed verbally). Held. Approve it with a note.
Same surcharge, held again. Approve it too, then check the Runs page: a rule change is suggested.

scenario: Learning loop 3: after applying the rule
story: Once the suggested tolerance is applied, this one goes straight through. Without it, it's held like the others.
